scope: Four-rank native FSDP2 audit on four fixed 128-token continuations. Same-displacement tests hold actual master snapshots fixed and also compare BF16-valued weights across forward arithmetic. Not a reconstruction of original E45/E47 late checkpoints.

loss-isolation.scope:
Four-rank real-teacher MDPO diagnostic on four fixed math continuations.

Requires four GPUs and saved fixed-prefix records. Packed SDPA comparisons are
valid here only because each rank/micro-batch contains exactly one sequence.
Use on an allocated GPU pool; the memory cap is not a scheduler reservation.

Uses the production FSDP2 engine, global token normalization, anchor scope and
AdamW. This creates a local low-KL state, not a reconstruction of the original
on-policy E45/E47 history. Pre/post evaluation uses FP64 row arithmetic.

effective-step-v2.scope: Same actual Adam displacement: isolate weight casting from forward arithmetic.

layer-precision.scope: Same actual Adam displacement: isolate weight casting from forward arithmetic.

same-math-attention.scope:
Hold the exact Adam displacement fixed and isolate forward precision.

Four ranks, four fixed prefixes. Native teacher/anchor log probabilities stay
fixed across all evaluations. mode_anchor_kl additionally measures each execution
mode relative to its own initial output, removing static dtype-switch offsets.
Movement mode captures actual master shards (optional --save-snapshots); layer
mode reuses those shards and promotes Qwen2 prefixes/suffixes to FP32 arithmetic
while retaining the same BF16-valued weights. Single sequence per rank only.
